post.summary: Delete a bucket. Bucket MUST be empty (no active blobs); pass `force=true` to cascade-delete all blobs first. Bytes in B2 / Vultr Object Storage are reaped asynchronously by `yata.storage.bucket.reap` BPMN.

force.description: If true, also delete all blobs in this bucket.

post.summary: Delete an object. If versioning is enabled, inserts a delete marker and keeps prior versions. If versioning is disabled, marks status='deleted' and schedules byte reap. Set `purge=true` to also delete from B2 / Vultr OS immediately (irreversible).

get.summary: Read an object's metadata + (optionally) inline bytes. This XRPC is for control-plane reads (small payloads or metadata-only).

data.description: Base64-encoded body (omitted when metadataOnly=true or sizeBytes > 5MB).

get.summary: Object existence + metadata probe (S3 HeadObject equivalent). Counts as Class B request for billing.

post.summary: Abort an in-progress multipart upload. Schedules byte cleanup on B2 / Vultr OS. Idempotent.
Complete a multipart upload. Caller MUST submit the parts list with their etags in order. Returns the final blob etag + cid + sizeBytes.
Initiate a multipart upload. Returns `uploadId` for use with subsequent multipartPart / multipartComplete / multipartAbort calls. State is tracked in vertex_yata_multipart with TTL 24h.
Upload one part. partNumber must be 1..10000. Each part except the last must be at least 5 MiB. Returns the part's etag for `multipartComplete`. Counts as Class A request.

Mint a time-limited HTTPS URL for direct GET / PUT against B2 / Vultr OS, signed by yatabase using the platform-side credentials. Caller never sees the upstream provider key. URL is intended to be handed to a browser / non-yatabase client.

contentType.description: For PUT — locks the Content-Type that the eventual upload must declare.

headers.description: JSON object of additional headers the client must send (e.g. x-amz-content-sha256).

post.summary: Provision a per-tenant Kotoba/Datomic database for the caller's org_did. Creates `yata_<sha256(did)[:16]>` database + dedicated PG ROLE + applies storage schema migration inside the new DB. Idempotent. Caller MUST be `did:web:billing.etzhayyim.com` admin or an authorized provisioning agent.

force.description: Re-provision even if a database exists for this org.

pgPasswordOnce.description: Raw PG password — returned ONCE, never persisted in plaintext.

post.summary: Upload an object via XRPC. Body MUST be `application/json` carrying base64-encoded bytes for files ≤ 5 MB; for larger uploads use `multipartInit` / `multipartPart` / `multipartComplete`. The bytes go to the bucket's tier-1 storage (Vultr OS HOT or B2 WARM per bucket policy); metadata + checksum are written to vertex_yata_blob.

vaultMemberDid.description: Required when encryption=vault-e2e (caller pre-encrypts with member device key).

ifNoneMatch.description: Set to '*' for create-only semantics (fails 412 if blob exists).

post.summary: Execute a read-only openCypher query against the caller's tenant graph. Translated to SQL/PGQ by kagami-cypher-compiler in the bpmn-dispatcher LangServer pool, then executed on Kotoba/Datomic. WRITE clauses (CREATE / MERGE / SET / DELETE) are rejected at the edge in Phase P4a; lifted in Phase 7. ADR-2605080000 D13.

parametersJson.description: JSON-encoded parameter map; nested JSON keeps Lexicon validator happy (no array-of-object inline).

format.description: Result data contents shape, Neo4j HTTP API parity.

rowsJson.description: JSON-encoded rows array; each row is an array aligned with columns.

translatedSql.description: The SQL/PGQ that was executed (for debugging).

post.summary: Execute a SPARQL 1.1 SELECT or CONSTRUCT query against the caller's tenant graph. Translated to SQL/PGQ via `v_rdf_triple` view (see graph reasoner schema 2026-05-01). UPDATE / DELETE shapes are deferred to Phase 2.

rows.description: JSON-encoded rows when format=json; raw CSV/TSV otherwise.

translatedSql.description: The SQL/PGQ that was executed (for debugging).

post.summary: Submit a 3D design request (text / image / CAD code) and start a LangGraph run that produces .glb mesh + .vox voxel artifacts on B2. Returns immediately with run_id; poll getRun for status. Per ADR-2605080700.

kind.description: Input modality. text = TRELLIS text→3D, image = ComfyUI 3D-Pack image→3D, cad = CadQuery Python exec→mesh.

prompt.description: Required when kind=text. Free-text description of the design (e.g., 'a small wooden cabin with a stone chimney').

imageUrl.description: Required when kind=image. Public URL or B2 presigned URL of the reference image.

cadCode.description: Required when kind=cad. CadQuery Python source code that builds a single Workplane / Compound and assigns it to a variable named `result`.

referenceArtifactId.description: Optional vertex_voxelforge_artifact.vertex_id of a prior artifact to use as conditioning input.

targetFormat.description: Output format(s) to materialize. 'both' produces .glb + .vox + voxel_grid.json + manifest.json.

targetVoxelDim.description: Target voxel grid edge length (cubic). 64 default. Higher = larger .vox file. Ignored when targetFormat=glb only.

params.description: Free-form generator-specific parameters (e.g., { seed: 42, sampleSteps: 25 }). Passed through to TRELLIS / ComfyUI / CadQuery exec.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(designId). Use with getRun to poll.

post.summary: Submit a quality-inspection report for a production order. When result='pass' or 'conditional_pass', the associated productionOrder transitions to status='passed' and (if escrow_intent payment) triggers on-chain USDC settlement via @etzhayyim/sdk pay(). Per ADR-2605202900 — settlement is the on-chain tx; before this call the buyer's USDC has NOT moved.

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the productionOrder being inspected.

inspectorDid.description: DID of the inspector (3rd-party QA agent or in-house QA actor).

result.description: pass / conditional_pass trigger settlement; fail / rework_required hold the order in production.

status.description: recorded = inspection written but no settlement (fail/rework). settled = inspection passed AND escrow_intent settled on-chain. settlementFailed = inspection passed but pay() reverted (the inspection record is still written for audit; caller can retry settlement).

paymentSentUri.description: AT URI of the payment.sent record (when status='settled').

txHash.description: Base L2 tx hash of the USDC settlement (when status='settled').

get.summary: Get milestone timeline for a production order (newest first by default).

post.summary: Report a production milestone (factory-side updates as work progresses). Each milestone is an append-only AT record per ADR-2605202800 (record-log semantics, no MST mutation). Milestones do NOT change productionOrder.status — that requires updateStatus per slice 4 with state-machine validation.

Cancel a production order. Per ADR-2605202800 Phase 2, cancellation before delivery writes an escrowRefund record (no on-chain tx — escrow_intent never settled). Cancellation after delivery is structurally impossible (USDC already transferred via SDK pay()). Cancellable statuses: pending / accepted / material-procurement.

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the production order to cancel.

cancelledByDid.description: DID of the actor requesting cancellation (customer / manufacturer / arbiter).

status.description: cancelled = order successfully transitioned to cancelled state; cannotCancel = order already in terminal state (delivered/cancelled) or past cancellable window.

escrowRefundUri.description: AT URI of the escrow refund record (when escrow_intent was used). Refund is a record-only state transition — no on-chain transfer happened, so no on-chain refund needed.

post.summary: Create a B2B production order against a registered manufacturer. Per ADR-2605202800 Phase 2, payment.method='escrow_intent' opens a deferred-payment intent AT record; actual USDC transfer occurs at delivery confirmation via @etzhayyim/sdk pay(). Cancellation before delivery writes a refund record (no on-chain tx since no transfer happened).

factoryDid.description: Optional specific factory DID under manufacturer.

productSpec.description: Product specification (free-form per industry — CAD CIDs, BOM, quantities, etc.).

payment.description: Payment intent. Per ADR-2605172100 etzhayyim is on-chain only; tsukuru Phase 2 uses deferred escrow_intent (intent record at create, SDK pay() at delivery, refund record at cancel).

method.description: escrow_intent = intent record at create, pay() at delivery, refund at cancel. direct_pay = SDK pay() immediately at order create (no cancellation refund possible).

amountUsdcMicros.description: Total amount in USDC micros (6 decimals; 10 USDC = 10_000_000).

tokenContract.description: ERC-20 token contract. Default: USDC on Base (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913).

post.summary: Start a Baien (BitNet b1.58) LoRA-on-bf16-master fine-tune (ADR 2605092350). baseModel.description: HF model id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 (BAIEN_DEFAULT_TRUNK_MODEL).

requantizeAfterTrain.description: If true, re-quantize merged adapter+master to i2_s and record the ternary blob alongside the bf16 checkpoint.

perplexityDriftCeiling.description: Max allowed perplexity drift vs unquantized master on a held-out set (default 0.05 = 5%).

i2sBlobUri.description: B2 URI of the i2_s ternary-packed blob produced by re-quantization, if requantizeAfterTrain was true.

perplexityDrift.description: Measured perplexity drift vs unquantized master on the held-out set.

encoderModel.description: HF id of the frozen encoder (e.g. google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384, openai/whisper-tiny, google/yamnet).

projectorTokens.description: Number of latent tokens emitted by the projector (image=64, audio-speech=32, audio-env=16).

post.summary: Baien-MX (ADR 2605101000) — train per-modality 1.58-bit projectors + the shared cross-modal fusion block on Kotoba/Datomic-native multimodal samples (v_training_multimodal_sample snapshot). baseModel.description: BitNet trunk HF id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16.

fusionLayerIndex.description: Trunk layer at which to insert the fusion block. Default 15 = L/2 for the 30-layer 2B trunk.

trunkFrozen.description: Freeze the BitNet trunk during training. Default true for v0.

loraOverFirst4Layers.description: Optional v1: per-modality rank-≤16 LoRA over the trunk's first 4 layers. Default false.

learningRate.description: Default LR shared by projectors that do not appear in perModalityLearningRates.

projectorCheckpoints.description: JSON-encoded {modality: checkpointVertexId} map, one row per trained projector (kind=baien-mx-projector-{modality}).

alpha.description: Mix between distill loss and ground-truth loss.

IMS BGCF / MGCF / IBCF — bridge a voice call to an interconnect peer (PSTN gateway / SIP trunk / IMS-IMS peering). Links voice_call to Phase 3 interconnect_agreement + roaming_partner.
OSS NOC — clear an alarm and compute MTTR (mean time to repair) from raised_at to cleared_at. Mutates the alarm row in place.
Close an intercept warrant (auto on validUntil expiry, manual on revocation, or on closure of investigation). Sets retention_until per jurisdiction-specific evidence retention rules.
OSS NOC — correlate child alarms under a parent (root cause), suppressing storm. ruleRef points to a DMN rule (com.etzhayyim.dmn.*) or a vault://rule pointer.
LICF (X1) — deactivate interception against a previously-activated target. Updates the existing target row in place.
5G SCP — delegated NF discovery (SCP queries NRF on behalf of consumer NF). Records candidate set + selected NF + selection strategy.
Delete an eSIM profile from eUICC storage (GSMA SGP.22 §3.3). Irreversible — profile must be disabled first. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

DF3 (X3) — deliver Communication Content (CC) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash + encryption pointer persisted in graph; the CC payload itself goes directly DF3 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
DF2 (X2) — deliver Intercept-Related Information (IRI) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash persisted in graph; the IRI payload itself goes directly DF2 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
O-RAN Near-RT RIC — deploy an xApp (near-RT RIC application). Lists supported RAN functions + bound E2 nodes.
Disable an active eSIM profile on eUICC without deletion (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'disabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
EES (Edge Enabler Server) — record an EAS discovery request from an Edge Enabler Client / Application Client. UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash.
Initiate eSIM profile download from SM-DP+ to eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.1). EID and ICCID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_profile record.
5G Core CHF — emit a 5G charging data record (Nchf_ConvergedCharging). Bridges 5G PDU session usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup.

IMS CDF / TAS — emit an IMS-specific billing event (3GPP Rf interface). Bridges voice call usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup; complements Phase 4 emitChargingDataRecord which is data-plane only.
5G NWDAF — emit a periodic analytics result for an active subscription. Only payload metadata (hash + size + vault:// ref) persisted in graph.
Enable an installed eSIM profile on eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'enabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
Enable Frame Replication & Elimination for Reliability (IEEE 802.1CB) on an existing TSN stream. Replication kind picks how diverse paths are computed.
NSACF — Network Slice Admission Control Function (3GPP TS 29.536). Enforces max registered UEs / max established sessions per S-NSSAI; SUPI-aware admission decisions.
Record an SLA / QoS breach against a provisioned service and open an escalation ticket.
5G Core SMF — establish a PDU session (Nsmf_PDUSession) with selected slice / DNN / UPF / RAN node and active policy decision.
5G SEPP — establish an N32-c security context to a peer PLMN's SEPP (3GPP TS 33.501 §13.2). certificateRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw cert/key never persisted.
IMS S-CSCF / TAS — record SIP INVITE → 200 OK → ACK call setup. Caller/callee MSISDN persisted as hashes; IMPU/SIP URI as plain (already public-style identifier).
OSS NMS — record a capacity forecast for a scope+metric. Sets breachPredicted=true when forecastValue exceeds capacityLimit; designed for timer-start (R/PT24H or R/P7D).
VNFM — heal a VNF (restart / re-instantiate / live-migrate). alarmVid may reference a Phase 7 alarm.
MEC orchestrator — instantiate an Edge Application Server (EAS) on a registered MEC host from an onboarded app package. Phase 10 (3GPP TS 23.558).
NFVO — instantiate a Network Service from an onboarded NSD against one or more VIMs. parameters carry instantiation knobs (string-encoded TOSCA inputs).
VNFM — instantiate a VNF/CNF from a VNFD on a chosen VIM under an NS. Optional `mappedNfInstanceId` ties this VNF back to the Phase 4 5G NF instance it implements.
Issue a customer bill via TMF678 Customer Bill Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_bill record. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).
NPN UDR — upsert a SUPI ↔ GPSI mapping (Generic Public Subscription Identifier — MSISDN/external_id/IMEI). SUPI/GPSI persisted as sha256 hashes.
MEC — onboard an edge application package (AppD descriptor) into the catalog. packageRef must be vault://; appDescriptor + raw container image never persisted.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a Network Service Descriptor (NSD) into the catalog. Phase 12 SDN-NFV control plane. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
O-RAN Non-RT RIC — onboard an rApp (non-RT RIC application) to SMO. packageRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw package never persisted in graph.
Onboard a new telecom subscriber. PII (customerName) is stored Tier-3 per ADR-0018; AT Repo holds hashed identity only.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a VNFD (VM-based) or CNFD (cloud-native, helm chart) into the catalog. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
MNP port-in request — receive a subscriber from a donor partner.
MNP port-out request — release a subscriber to a recipient partner. authCodeIssued is the porting auth code returned to the subscriber.
Provision a DWDM lightpath / spectrum slot between two ROADMs through pre-validated fiber spans. centerFrequencyGhz on flex-grid (e.g. 193.1 THz center + multiples of channelGridGhz).
Register a new eUICC device in the graph (SGP.22 §2 EID provisioning). EID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_euicc record.
Provision a gPTP (IEEE 802.1AS-2020) sync profile with grandmaster + redundant GMs. priority1/priority2 follow PTPv2 BMCA.
NTN — provision an inter-satellite link (ISL) between two satellites. Optical (LCT) or RF, with optional encryption key reference (vault://).
NTN — provision a non-terrestrial cell on a satellite (3GPP TS 38.821). cellPattern = moving (LEO sweep) / earth_fixed (steered) / quasi_earth_fixed.
O-RAN O2 — SMO requests O-Cloud (IMS infrastructure / DMS deployment) resource provisioning. interfaceKind distinguishes O2-IMS vs O2-DMS.
Provision an OTN connection (ITU-T G.709) carried inside a DWDM channel. clientServiceVid optionally references a Phase 1 service / Phase 4 PDU session / Phase 9 O-RAN xHaul / Phase 14 NTN feeder.
Hotspot 2.0 PPS-MO (Per-Provider Subscription Management Object) provisioning. credentialRef must be vault://; raw EAP credentials never persist. ppsMoRef stores the full MO XML out-of-band.
NPN — provision a Public-Network-Integrated NPN slice (PNI-NPN). Slice runs on hosting PLMN with optional CAG access restriction + tenant isolation.
NPN — provision 5G ProSe (Proximity Services) direct communication / sidelink (3GPP TS 23.304). prosePolicyRef must be vault://; raw policy body never persisted.
SDN controller — install / modify / delete a flow rule on a southbound switch (OpenFlow / P4Runtime / NETCONF / OVSDB / gNMI). matchHash + actionHash only; raw match/action bodies via vault://.
Provision a telecom service instance (voice/data/SMS/IoT) with QoS profile + APN.
Publish or update a product offering in the TMF620 Product Catalog. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_offering record.
OSS NOC — raise an alarm against a network entity (cell site, RAN node, NF instance, asset, or service). 3GPP TS 32.111 / ITU-T X.733 fault management shape.
ANQP / Hotspot 2.0 GAS query audit. UE MAC address persisted only as sha256 hash; ANQP response body persisted as sha256 hash + size.
O-RAN E2 — record an E2 INDICATION message from E2 Node to xApp. headerHash + messageHash only; ASN.1 PER body never persisted.
NTN — record a feeder-link or TT&C contact window between an earth station and a satellite. AOS / LOS times define the window; duration_seconds computed automatically.
MEC — record a UE/AC ↔ EAS service call (HTTP/gRPC method + status + latency + IO byte counts). UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash; EAS payload body never persisted.
NTN — record an ephemeris snapshot for a satellite (TLE / OMM / SP3 / 3GPP-NTN). Body persisted via vault://+sha256.
Record an interconnect-traversed CDR (POI / hub). MSISDN values stored as hashes (Tier-3 PII not persisted plaintext at this boundary).
NTN — record a handover event between NTN cells / satellites or between NTN ↔ terrestrial. Doppler offset + one-way propagation delay captured for QoS audit.
Record an optical-layer alarm (LOS / LOF / LOS-P / BDI / TIM / DEG / BER / OSNR-min). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record an optical performance-monitoring event (rx-power, tx-power, OSNR, pre-FEC-BER, Q-factor, CD/PMD). breach=true when |value| crosses slaThreshold.
Record a product instance in the TMF637 Product Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_inventory record.
5G SEPP — record an N32-c (control) or N32-f (forwarding) message exchange. Payload hash + security verification result only; payload body never persisted.
Record a service instance in the TMF638 Service Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_inventory record.
Record an incident on a cell site / RAN node. Drives downstream SLA breach (Phase 1 escalateSlaBreach).
Record a TSN stream SLA breach (latency / jitter / frame loss). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record a gPTP / PTP sync deviation observed by a bridge. breach=true when offsetNs/pathDelayNs exceeds profile thresholds (computed by primitive).
Record a TAP 3.12 batch file aggregate (counts + total charge per file). Per-call detail rows go to recordInterconnectCdr.
5G SEPP — record N32 trust / cipher / IPX modification policy negotiation outcome with a peer SEPP (or via IPX provider).
Record a CDR (Call Detail Record) for voice / SMS / data / IoT usage.
Wi-Fi roaming AAA exchange (RADIUS / Diameter via DRR / RoamServer). Captures session-time + ingress/egress bytes per partner for downstream settlement.
NPN — register a Closed Access Group (CAG) within an SNPN. Restricts which UEs may camp on which Phase 2 cellSite/ranNode.
Register a cell site (TMF639 Resource Inventory). Latitude/longitude only — tower owner contact PII held elsewhere.
Register or update a customer billing account via TMF666 Account Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_account record. PII fields are hashed.
NTN — register an earth station / satellite gateway. Bound to a peering NF (Phase 4) for traffic ingress.
MEC Federation (GSMA OPG / ETSI MEC Fed) — register a federation partnership with another operator's MEC platform under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
ETSI MEC — register a MEC host (edge compute node hosting EAS workloads). Phase 10 edge plane. Bound to a Phase 9 O-Cloud and ranNode for locality affinity.
Register a fiber span between two ROADMs. Captures SMF/NZDSF type + length + attenuation + dispersion + amplifier (EDFA/Raman/hybrid) for GNPy planning.
Hotspot 2.0 venue (BSS + OSU) registration. HESSID + SSID + advertised RCOI list per ANQP. ssid is broadcast public; no PII concern.
IMS HSS — register an IMS user-profile subscription (IMPI ↔ IMPU list ↔ S-CSCF). Phase 5 voice control plane.

Lawful Intercept (CALEA / ETSI LI / 3GPP TS 33.127) — register a warrant authorizing intercept against named identifiers. warrantDocumentRef is a vault:// pointer; warrant body never persisted in graph.
Register an interconnect / wholesale agreement with a peer carrier (MNO / MVNO). Phase 3 telecom Supplier/Partner domain.
Register a physical network asset (router / fiber / antenna / battery) with serial# tracking.
5G Core SBA — register a Network Function instance with the NRF (Nnrf_NFManagement). Phase 4 control plane.
NPN — register a Network Identifier (NID) allocation. assignmentKind=self → self-assigned (collision risk); assignmentKind=coordinated → IEEE Registration Authority via OUI prefix.
NPN — enroll an existing 5G subscriber profile (Phase 4) into an SNPN or PNI-NPN with optional CAG membership and device class scope.
NTN — register a satellite operator roaming partnership (Starlink / OneWeb / Iridium / SES / Inmarsat) under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
Register an MSISDN range allocation from the regulator (E.164, country code + range bounds).
TIP Phoenix MUST optical domain — controller scope (TransportPCE / Goldstone / GNPy / vendor controller). Phase 16 transport plane.
Register an Optical Line System (OLS) per TIP MUST OLS specification — bundle of ROADMs / amplifiers / fiber spans under a domain controller.
Register a RAN node (gNB / eNB / DU / CU) bound to a cell site and a spectrum license.
Register a ROADM node within an OLS. Bound to Phase 2 cellSite via siteId, Phase 2 networkAsset via attachedAssetId.
Register a TAP 3.12 roaming partner (TADIG code, IMSI prefix, SCCP GT prefix) under an existing interconnect agreement.
NTN — register a satellite asset. NORAD ID + International Designator are public catalog identifiers (no PII). Phase 14 satellite plane.
IMS P-CSCF — record a SIP REGISTER (UE attach to IMS). Binds an IMPU to a contact URI for the duration of the registration.
Register a pending profile event on SM-DS (GSMA SGP.22 §3.6). The eUICC polls SM-DS and retrieves the event to initiate profile download. EID sha256: hashed.
O-RAN SMO — register a Service Management & Orchestration node hosting Non-RT RIC + O1/O2 northbound endpoints. Phase 9 Open RAN control plane.
NPN — register a Stand-alone Non-Public Network deployment (3GPP TS 23.501 §5.30). Phase 11 enterprise private 5G control plane.
Register a spectrum license (TMF634 Resource Catalog). Phase 2 telecom Resource domain.

5G Core — register a UDM/UDR subscriber profile (SUPI ↔ slice subscription / DNN list / AMBR / AKA credential ref). SUPI persisted as hash; akaCredentialRef is a vault:// pointer (raw K never persisted).
5G Core AMF — record a UE registration (initial / mobility / periodic). Binds Phase 2 RAN node to a 5G subscriber profile.
Register a TSN bridge / endpoint in a domain. attachedAssetId may reference a Phase 2 networkAsset for inventory linkage.
TSN domain (IEEE 802.1Q-2022). Defines gPTP / SRP scope. Optionally bound to a Phase 11 SNPN for industrial 5G integration. Phase 15 deterministic plane.
WBA OpenRoaming / Hotspot 2.0 — register a Roaming Consortium Organization Identifier (RCOI). Phase 13 Wi-Fi convergence.

MEC orchestrator — record an EAS relocation (ACR — Application Context Relocation) between MEC hosts. Trigger may reference Phase 7 capacity_forecast (breach), Phase 4 ue_mobility (handover), or Phase 8 NWDAF SERVICE_EXPERIENCE.
Open a vendor RMA case for a faulty network asset.
Reserve a deterministic stream (IEEE 802.1Q SRP / Qcc CNC). pathBridgeIds is the ordered talker→listener path computed by the controller.
5G SEPP — record an N32 cryptographic key rotation. Only key hashes persisted in graph; newKeyRef is a vault:// pointer.
IMS E-CSCF — record routing of an emergency call (911/112/119/110/118) to a PSAP. Caller location persisted (regulatory requirement) but treated Tier-3.
5G SCP — record an SBI service request routing event (3GPP TS 23.501 §6.2.18). Request URI persisted as sha256 hash; body never persisted.
Aggregate CDRs for a subscriber over a period and emit an invoice. Designed to be invoked from a timer-start BPMN (R/P1M).
VNFM — scale a VNF horizontally (instance count) or vertically (resource per instance). triggerVid may reference Phase 7 capacity_forecast or Phase 8 NWDAF NF_LOAD.
Schedule a preventive / corrective maintenance window on a site / node / asset.
5G Core NSSF — record a network slice selection (S-NSSAI mapping) for a UE registration.
Aggregate inbound + outbound TAP files for a partner over a period and emit a net settlement invoice. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).
Aggregate Wi-Fi roaming exchanges per partner over a period and emit a settlement invoice. Mirrors Phase 3 settleRoamingInvoice (cellular TAP) for Wi-Fi traffic. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).

OSS NMS — capture a configuration snapshot of a scope (NF instance, RAN node, transport device). Compares configHash against baselineSnapshotId to detect drift; raw config body persisted only via vault:// configRef.
OSS — submit an ITIL change request (RFC). planRef / rollbackPlanRef point to vault:// or document refs. Approval flow handled by approveChangeRequest.
Submit a product order via TMF622 Product Ordering Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_order record.
Submit a service order via TMF641 Service Ordering Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_order record.
O-RAN E2 — xApp subscribes to an E2 service (KPM / RC / NI / CCC) on an E2 Node with event trigger + action definition.
5G NWDAF — subscribe to a network data analytics report (3GPP TS 23.288 Nnwdaf_AnalyticsSubscription). Phase 8 control plane.
OSS NOC — suppress an active alarm temporarily (planned maintenance window or known-issue). Mutates the alarm row in place.
MEC orchestrator — terminate an EAS instance. Mutates the existing EAS row in place and computes lifetime_seconds.
NFVO — terminate a Network Service. Mutates the existing NS row + computes lifetime_seconds; cascading VNF termination tracked separately by VNFM.
IMS TAS — record SIP BYE / CANCEL / 4xx-5xx-6xx response. Updates voice_call status + duration; never persists media content.
Transfer eSIM profile ownership from one MNO SM-DP+ to another (MNO-to-MNO porting, GSMA SGP.22 Annex H). Records transfer audit trail. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

post.summary: Register a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifact with sbom.etzhayyim.com. Software SBOMs (cargo-cyclonedx output) and vehicle BOMs (kami-cad-import output, type=device per part) flow through the same SbomArtifact graph and CVE / recall pipeline (60-apps/etzhayyim-project-sbom/CLAUDE.md). For vehicle BOMs the optional vehicle* fields capture the part-graph metadata needed for Takata-style supplier recall queries.

format.description: Wire format. CycloneDX 1.5 is the default for both software and vehicle BOMs.

vehicleId.description: Stable vehicle id (e.g. mx5-na-1989). Present for vehicle BOMs only — software SBOMs leave this unset.

totalMassKg.description: Vehicle BOMs only — sum of effective_mass_kg across parts.

partCount.description: Vehicle BOMs only — number of CDX components.[type=device].

sourceUri.description: URI of the source artifact that produced this SBOM (e.g. scad://etzhayyim/roadster-na/v0.1.0, b2://drive/cad/...).

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the source artifact. Used for deterministic SBOM serial number.

license.description: SPDX expression covering the source artifact (e.g. MIT, CC-BY-4.0, proprietary).

cdxJson.description: Full CycloneDX 1.5 (or SPDX 3.0) document, encoded as a JSON string. Validated server-side against the upstream schema.

artifactUri.description: AT URI of the SbomArtifact graph node (at://did:web:sbom.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.sbom.artifact/<rkey>).

componentCount.description: Number of CDX components ingested into the SbomComponent graph.

vulnMatchCount.description: Number of vulnerability matches detected synchronously against the existing CveEntry graph.

Conversational agent for otakiage. Multi-turn conversation backed by LangGraph (intent classification → action branch → response composition、3 LLM call で ADR-2605072000 の intra-job ≥3 LLM branches 条件を満たす)。supported intents: submit (物品登録の対話)、search (近接 reuse 候補の検索)、ritual (供養依頼)、inquire (matsuri / certificate 質問)、chat (一般会話)。会話 state は vertex_otakiage_conversation + vertex_otakiage_conversation_turn に永続化、threadId で会話を継続。

message.description: ユーザのメッセージ (日本語可)

callerDid.description: 発話者 DID。会話の owner、submit や request の actor になる

threadId.description: 既存会話の継続。omit 時は新規 thread を発行

intentHint.description: 明示の intent (任意、UI ボタン等から)。omit 時は LLM が分類

h3Cell.description: 発話者の H3 res-5 cell (search intent で近接マッチに使用)

maxTurns.description: 保持する直近の会話 turn 数 (LLM context 投入)

threadId.description: 新規 / 継続 thread URI

reply.description: agent からの自然言語応答

uri.description: drafted/submitted item URI、または提示した URI

details.description: JSON 文字列 (kind 別の詳細データ)

draftItem.description: submit intent 中で抽出された下書き (確認後に submitItem で確定)

llmCalls.description: この turn で実行された LLM call 数 (≥3 が graph contract)

post.summary: 供養証跡 (certificate) を ERC725 anchor token として on-chain に固定する (Phase 2b1)。authority gated (issuer = did:web:otakiage.etzhayyim.com:ritual のみ)。Phase 2b1 = state tracking のみ (`anchor_status: pending → queued`)、Phase 2b2 で実 on-chain 取引を ethers/viem 経由で実装。anchored 状態に到達した certificate は etzhayyim の blockchain 登記の延長として永続証跡を持つ。redo 不可 (1 certificate = 1 anchor token、token_id = sha256(certificate_json))。

Cancel an active subscription. Entitlement remains valid until periodEnd; no prorated refund at this layer (processor handles refund policy). Sets status=cancelled and disables auto-renew.

Register a creator profile on oshinobi. Caller DID becomes the creator. Age verification and payout KYC are delegated to external providers; server stores only the reference token and verification timestamp, never raw PII. Persist to vertex_oshinobi_creator (Tier 1 metadata) — displayName / bio / contentPolicy are public. payoutStatus reflects external KYC lifecycle.

ageVerificationRef.description: Opaque token from external age-verification provider (Jumio/Veriff/Yoti). Server does NOT see ID documents.

payoutProviderRef.description: Opaque reference from adult-content-capable payout processor (CCBill/Segpay/RocketGate). Server does NOT store bank details.

post.summary: Define a subscription tier for the caller creator. Price is integer USD cents; float prohibited (AT Lexicon + currency precision).

get.summary: Public profile view. Returns creator metadata + active tier list + tier-locked post count. Never returns PII / payout state.
Fetch a post. Server checks entitlement (vertex_oshinobi_subscription active + tierRequired match, OR PPV receipt). Unauthorized callers receive teaser only; body + mediaCids are stripped.
Liveness / readiness probe for oshinobi appview.
Chronological feed of posts across creators the caller is subscribed to. Each item has entitled:true|false; bodies are stripped for unentitled items. Supports contentLabel filter for age-gating.
List the caller-creator's payout ledger entries. Server-side filter by caller DID; creators cannot see each other's ledgers.
List the caller's subscriptions. Server-side filter by caller DID; cannot view another user's subscriptions.
List all active tiers for a creator.

post.summary: Publish a post gated by a tier. contentLabel drives both entitlement + social dispatch: only 'safe' posts emit a teaser via app.bsky.feed.post. 'adult' posts require caller.contentPolicy='adult_allowed'. body is stored as signal:v1:{ciphertext} when sensitivity>=2 (tier-gated), plaintext when sensitivity=1 (public teaser-safe).

tierRequired.description: tierId required to view. Empty string = public preview only.

teaser.description: Public teaser; always plaintext, no PII/explicit content.

body.description: Full content. Server applies signal:v1 encryption for contentLabel != 'safe'.

priceUsdCents.description: If >0, PPV (pay-per-view) post on top of tier access

teaserPostUri.description: app.bsky.feed.post URI if teaser was dispatched (contentLabel=safe only)

post.summary: User report against a post, creator, or tip. BPMN triage: LLM classifier assigns severity; severity=critical (CSAM, non-consensual) escalates to out-of-band review queue. Server stores reason as plaintext (moderator-readable); reporter DID is owner_did (RLS).

Subscribe the caller to a creator's tier. paymentToken is an opaque reference from the payment processor (CCBill/Segpay/RocketGate) — server does NOT see PAN/CVV. Server charges the token via BPMN http.fetch to the processor, then writes the subscription + entitlement edge. Idempotent per (subscriberDid, creatorDid, tierId).

paymentToken.description: Processor-issued one-time charge token. NEVER a raw card.

post.summary: One-off tip to a creator, optionally attached to a post. Like subscribe, paymentToken is an opaque processor reference. message is stored signal:v1-encrypted (Tier 2, creator-readable only). Emits payout_ledger delta.

postUri.description: Optional — tip targeted at a specific post

post.summary: Update creator profile. Only the creator DID itself may mutate. contentPolicy downgrade (adult_allowed → sfw_only) cascades to new posts only; existing posts retain their label.

Declare a control loop. A loop is one LangGraph graph containing N cells connected by typed event edges; one super-step covers all participating cells per ADR-2605151200 §LangGraph + Pregel binding.

superStepRateMillihz.description: Super-step rate in millihertz (1000 = 1 Hz, 100 = 0.1 Hz, 10000 = 10 Hz)

debounceMs.description: Coalesce signal-change triggers within this window into one super-step

post.summary: Declare a signal point (analog / digital / string). Engineering-unit ranges and deadbands are stored in micro-units (1e-6) so all values are integers (AT Lexicon prohibits float).

unitCode.description: UCUM unit code (e.g. kW, V, A, degC, m, %)

post.summary: Grant a host capability to a cell. Capabilities are capability-string-keyed (e.g. io:{signalDid}:read, peer:{cellDid}:msg, time:cycle, log:event).

get.summary: List faults filtered by device, loop, time window, or minimum severity.

List telemetry readings for a signal, ordered by ts descending. Backed by vertex_open_ot_reading; subject to dml_rate_limit on bulk historical queries.

post.summary: Change the operating mode of a loop. Subject to interlock DMN; safe-mode transitions are always permitted and may be auto-triggered by fault propagation.
Pin a built WASM cell artefact (.aot) by content-addressed CID and signature. The pin is an immutable record; cell upgrades require a new pinModule call and atomic two-phase swap.

moduleCid.description: Content hash (e.g. blake3 / sha256-multihash) of the AOT artefact

moduleSig.description: Detached signature over moduleCid by builderDid

builderDid.description: DID of the trusted builder that produced the AOT artefact

fbtypeXmlCid.description: Optional CID of the source 4diac FBType XML for round-trip provenance

sourceCommit.description: Optional VCS commit identifier of the BFB source

post.summary: Pod-side ingest from a Zenoh aggregator. Telemetry is NOT atproto records — it is bulk-INSERTed into vertex_open_ot_reading via SQLAlchemy on the LangServer pod. Bulk ingest uses SET dml_rate_limit per CLAUDE.md rw-bulk-insert-throttle.

aggregatorDid.description: DID of the Zenoh aggregator pod that produced this batch

batchSeq.description: Monotonic batch sequence per aggregator (gap detection)

post.summary: Report an OT fault. Severity is DMN-evaluated (1 = info, 2 = warning, 3 = alarm, 4 = critical). May link to an open-denki CIM fault for cross-domain correlation.

dmnInputsJson.description: Opaque JSON of DMN evaluation inputs for audit

post.summary: Operator or agent setpoint write to a signal. Routed XRPC → bpmn-dispatcher → AgentGateway MCP → LangServer pod → Zenoh publish per ADR-2605111200. Requires setpoint:write capability on the writing principal and DMN interlock pass.

valueMicroUnit.description: Setpoint value in micro-units (1e-6); must lie within signal euRange

unitCode.description: UCUM unit code (must equal the signal's unitCode)

expectedSuperStep.description: Optional super-step id at which the change should land (for scheduled setpoint cascades)

Run COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction over a curated image set. Pipeline: feature_extractor (SIFT CPU) → exhaustive_matcher → mapper (incremental SfM) → image_undistorter → patch_match_stereo (CPU, 4-thread) → stereo_fusion → delaunay_mesher. Inputs are Mapillary URLs (worker downloads to ephemeral /tmp); output is a vertex-colored triangle mesh stored in B2. Wall-clock budget per tile = 60 min hard timeout (BPMN boundary); typical 30-45 min on 2 cores @ 2.5 GHz with 30 images at 1080p. On failure emits a structured error so `replanReconstruction` can decide retry|downgrade-to-osm|abort.

denseEnabled.description: False = sparse-only fallback (skip patch_match_stereo). Default true.

matcher.description: exhaustive | sequential | spatial. Default exhaustive (best quality, slowest).

rawMeshUri.description: B2 URI of meshed.ply (vertex-colored triangle mesh) when ok=true.

errorCode.description: On failure: TOO_FEW_MATCHES | BUNDLE_DIVERGED | DENSE_OOM | TIMEOUT | UNKNOWN.

post.summary: LangGraph multi-step image curation. Input is the full Mapillary candidate set; output is 20-40 selected image IDs ordered by SfM utility. Nodes: score_quality (heuristic resolution + blur EXIF) → score_coverage (azimuthal + baseline diversity) → llm_dedupe (Murakumo Vision LLM near-dup collapse) → decide_count. Selected count caps COLMAP memory at ~16 GiB on a single CPU pod.

targetCount.description: Soft target for selected image count. Default 30.

minCount.description: Below this, mark tile as unreconstructable. Default 8.

abort.description: True if minCount not met; downstream tasks must short-circuit.

post.summary: Fetch Mapillary v4 image metadata for an H3 tile bbox. Used as a LangServer handler (`maps3d.fetchMapillary`) inside `processTile.bpmn`. Output is metadata only (image_id + camera_pose + captured_at + url); the actual JPEG fetch + B2 upload happens after image curation narrows the candidate set. Source DID `did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:street_view`.

maxImages.description: Hard cap on Mapillary results returned (default 200, max 500).

lookbackDays.description: Reject images older than this many days (default 1825 = 5y).

post.summary: LangGraph actor disambiguation. For each VisionResult detection, search Wikidata SPARQL + GLEIF + OSM operator/owner tags + Murakumo LLM disambiguator → emit a candidate `did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:registry:*:{code}` plus confidence. Strong matches get an `Operates` / `OwnsProperty` edge to the host Building vertex; weak matches stay as VisionResult-only. Per ADR-0036 the worker writes vertex / edge rows directly via Hyperdrive, no PDS round-trip.

minConfidence.description: Skip emitting an edge below this confidence (default 0.7).

buildingVertexId.description: vertex_id of the linked Building, when known.

evidenceJson.description: Compact JSON of the disambiguation trace for audit.

post.summary: Entry point for the maps3d photogrammetry pipeline. Triggers a single H3 tile through Mapillary fetch → image curation (LangGraph) → COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction → mesh simplification → Murakumo Vision annotation → actor disambiguation → vertex_spatial ingest. BPMN-as-actor (ADR-0056) — invoked via `POST http://dispatcher.etzhayyim.com:8080/xrpc/com.etzhayyim.apps.maps3d.processTile` or auto-fired by timer-start R/PT15M against `vertex_maps3d_tile WHERE status IN ('pending','stale')`. Real work runs in LangServer handlers under namespace `maps3d` in Vultr LKE. Backed by `00-contracts/bpmn/com/etzhayyim/maps3d/processTile.bpmn` v1, `vertex_id = at://did:web:bpmn.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.bpmn.processDef/maps3d-process-tile-v1`.

tileH3.description: H3 cell ID at resolution 12 (~9m edge) — the unit of reconstruction.

priority.description: Override row priority for this run (1 = landmark, 5 = backfill). Default reads from row.

force.description: Re-run even if status='done'. Default false.

instanceKey.description: LangServer run key — opaque identifier for tracing.

post.summary: LangGraph failure replanner. Takes a structured COLMAP failure (errorCode + errorMessage from `colmapTile`) and decides: retry-with-relaxed-thresholds | request-more-images | downgrade-to-osm-extrude | mark-unrecoverable. State is checkpointed to `vertex_langgraph_state` so a Pod restart resumes the same decision. The BPMN exclusive gateway routes accordingly; today the loop short-circuits to End on first failure (single-pass) — multi-pass replanning is deferred until the steady-state success rate is measured.

retryHints.description: Optional knobs the next colmapTile attempt should use.

post.summary: Open3D quadric-decimation + saturated vertex-color export to GLB. Reduces COLMAP raw mesh (50K-300K triangles) to ~5K triangles per tile so the kami-app-maps3d MeshTileAdapter can stream and upload to GPU without frame spikes. Per-vertex colors are saturated (factor 1.3, clamped) to bias the rendering toward Nintendo-style cel-shading rather than photoreal blur. Optionally segments the mesh by OSM building footprint so each building gets its own GLB + vertex_spatial Building row.

segmentByFootprint.description: When true, split into one GLB per OSM building. Default false (single tile GLB).

tileMeshUri.description: B2 URI of the simplified tile-level GLB.

post.summary: Run Murakumo Vision (qwen3-vl-8b) over the curated Mapillary images for a tile, extracting visible entities (Building, Storefront, Sign, Vehicle, Person...) plus OCR text. Emits one VisionResult per detected entity with bbox, label, confidence, and OCR. Re-uses the maps `analyze_image` / `vision_import_entities` pipeline (`60-apps/etzhayyim-project-maps/CLAUDE.md` §Vision Intelligence). Output is consumed by `linkActor` to bind detected entities to legal-entity DIDs.

minConfidence.description: Drop detections below this confidence. Default 0.55.

kind.description: Building | Storefront | Sign | Vehicle | Person | Spot | Place | ...

ocr.description: Concatenated OCR text within the bbox.

Forward-topology chunk reader. Takes an array of H3 cells + LOD (resolution) and returns the per-cell, per-label GeoJSON features intersecting each cell. Replaces XYZ tile pyramid with H3-indexed chunks. Server translates each cell → boundary polygon → bbox, unions the bounding boxes, queries vertex_spatial once, then routes features back to their owning cell by centroid. Self-hosted invariant: no external rigging service (Mixamo / AccuRIG etc.) is called from this path. External APIs are train-only teacher signals — see `data/ghosthacker/TRAINING_PIPELINE.md`. The conditional edge `dmn:com.etzhayyim.policies.mangaka.vrmBindRetry@1.0.0` routes `valid=false` back to bindVrm for one retry, otherwise the Pregel moves on to attachCharacterVrm. celex.description: CELEX identifier (e.g. '32016R0679' for GDPR). Mutually exclusive with since.

post.summary: Crawl US federal statutory material (CFR / USC) from GovInfo bulkdata. titleNumber.description: CFR title (1–50) or USC title (1–54). Omit to ingest the full title index.

year.description: Edition year (e.g. 2024 for CFR, 2023 for USC).

limit.description: Max statutes to ingest in one call (default 50, max 500).

post.summary: Crawl international treaties from the UN Treaty Collection (https://treaties.un.org/). Writes to vertex_houbun_treaty. Phase 2 contract surface is fixed; the parser lands in a later PR — currently a polite-crawl scaffold.

End-to-end FAX preparation + handoff in one call: takes text/markdown/HTML, renders to a print-ready Japanese A4 business letter PDF, uploads to CDN B2, and triggers the operator handoff. DEFAULT provider is 'manual' (Dropbox Fax UI) — the agent prepares everything and notifies the operator via mailer (Teams channel + email) with PDF URL + step-by-step instructions; operator does the final UI send. After operator confirms, call com.etzhayyim.apps.fax.confirmManualSend to close the audit chain. Phaxio API path is retained but marked as DEAD PATH (no creds in production). Use for compliance correspondence: 労基署 / 裁判所 / 内容証明 / 行政手続.

to.description: Recipient fax number (E.164, e.g. +81338188411). Leading 0 of JP numbers auto-converted.

content.description: Document body (plain text, markdown, or full HTML)

format.description: Format of `content`. text/markdown wrap in default Japanese business letter template; html used as-is.

subject.description: Letter title (centered as h1; ignored when format=html)

addressee.description: 宛名 metadata (used by text/markdown templates)

name.description: e.g. 中央労働基準監督署

subLine.description: e.g. 第2方面 福田彩乃 監督官 殿

sender.description: 差出人 metadata (used by text/markdown templates; falls back to actor profile)

caseId.description: Internal business case id (e.g. matsuoka-2504); propagated to faxTx + roukisho.communication record

officeId.description: roukisho officeId for cross-actor recordCommunication (e.g. jp-tokyo-chuo)

officeDid.description: Optional explicit roukisho sub-DID; derived from officeId if omitted

referenceNumber.description: External case ref (e.g. 中央基署呼発第10号) printed as document header

provider.description: auto = manual (Phaxio is dead path; only fires if provider='phaxio' explicit AND SS_FAX_API_KEY set). manual = Dropbox Fax UI handoff with operator notification.

blobKey.description: SHA-256 hex of rendered PDF in CDN_R2

publicUrl.description: Direct R2 URL of rendered PDF

humanInstructions.description: Returned when provider=manual or fallback. Tells operator how to send.

roukishoCommunicationId.description: Cross-actor record id when officeId supplied

post.summary: Mark a manual-handoff faxTx (status='needs_human') as completed once the operator has sent the FAX via the Dropbox Fax UI (or alternative). providerFaxId.description: Provider-side id (e.g. Dropbox Fax transmission id) if known

blobKey.description: R2 CDN blob key of the inbound PDF

get.summary: List previously sent faxes (optionally filtered by caseId / recipient / status).

post.summary: Render a document (text/markdown/HTML) to a print-ready A4 PDF using Cloudflare Browser Rendering (Chromium headless). text and markdown are wrapped in a Japanese business-letter template (Hiragino Mincho ProN). Output is uploaded to CDN_R2 keyed by SHA-256 of the PDF bytes. Returns blobKey usable by com.etzhayyim.apps.fax.send.
Send a FAX via Dropbox Fax / Phaxio-compatible provider. Input = recipient fax number (E.164) + document reference (B2 blobKey or public URL). Returns provider faxId + local txId.

from.description: Sender fax number or caller ID (optional, provider default)

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the document (alternative to blobKey)

post.summary: Upload an arbitrary document (PDF/image) to CDN_R2. Content-addressed: blobKey = SHA-256 hex of bytes; uploads are deduped (HEAD-then-PUT). Returns blobKey for use by com.etzhayyim.apps.fax.send. Use this when you already have a finished PDF and only need transmission.

newPrecedentUri.description: AT URI of the new precedent if council modified or overturned (uses supersedesPrecedent link).

contentUri.description: URI of the content being classified (AT URI / URL / IPFS CID).

contentMetadata.description: Open object — metadata schema varies by content type.

encrypted.description: If true, classification uses Murakumo Gemma local fallback (no external LLM).

llmTier.description: T1 Clear Eros / T2 Eros Borderline / T3 Neutral / T4 Gore Borderline / T5 Clear Gore

councilDeferralUri.description: If T2/T4 and no precedent matched, AT URI of the Council deliberation request.

subjectDescription.description: Canonical description of the content category this precedent governs.

originalJudgingUri.description: AT URI of the eros-gore-judging that triggered Council deliberation.

councilRationale.description: Full Council reasoning. Public + permanent. Future similar cases applied directly without Council re-deliberation.

supersedesPrecedent.description: Optional AT URI of an earlier precedent this one revises/overturns.

supersededBy.description: Set by a later precedent when this one is overturned.

lessonsLearned.description: Public + permanent record. Religious-corp collective memory.

selfCritiqueCid.description: IPFS CID of optional self-critique document from operating actors.

proportionalityAnalysis.description: Analysis of proportionality vs threat. Religious accountability standard.

thirdPartyReviewCid.description: Optional independent legal / ethical review reference.

emergencyDeclared.description: If true, requests 24h emergency voting (requires concurrent Council Lv6+ ≥3 emergency attestation).

authorizationUri.description: AT URI of the prior force-authorization-proposal that approved this action.

locationCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of location data (GPS coordinates / GeoJSON area / 'redacted' for adherent safety).

casualties.description: Required field. Religious-corp accountability standard demands explicit transparency.

designSpecCid.description: IPFS CID of full design specification (markdown / PDF). Draft acceptable at proposal time.

safetyAnalysisCid.description: IPFS CID of safety analysis document. Required.

dualUseAnalysis.description: Constitutional REQUIREMENT per ADR-2605192315 §4: explicit analysis of how this design could be misused by adversaries + mitigations. Charter Rider §2 exposure analysis included.

finalDesignCid.description: IPFS CID of finalized design + implementation + tests.

openSourceLicense.description: Constitutionally fixed. Other licenses (proprietary / NC / source-available) NOT permitted for force R&D.

repoPath.description: Path in 60-apps/etzhayyim-transparent-force-rd/ where the project lives.

boundaryVerified.description: Steward physically inspected boundary; matches geojsonCid.

boundaryDeltaCid.description: IPFS CID of optional boundary delta document if encroachment / shift observed.

biodiversityRecordUri.description: AT URI of the linked land-biodiversity record for this year.

accessProvided.description: Steward provided reasonable access to etzhayyim adherents for religious gathering / meditation during the year.

commercialExtractionAbsent.description: No commercial extraction (mining / clear-cut / large-scale monoculture) occurred. Required true per ADR-2605192245 §5.1.

nationalObligationsCurrent.description: Property tax / national obligations paid in full (dual-recognition responsibility).

satelliteImageryCid.description: IPFS CID of the year's satellite imagery snapshot (compared against donation baseline + prior years).

ndviChange.description: NDVI vegetation change index vs prior year, scaled by 10000 (e.g., +500 = +5% green cover).

submittedBy.description: DID of the submitter. Can be steward, Adherent, or external party.

oathText.description: Full canonical land-donation oath text as signed by donor.

donorSignature.description: DID-bound signature over the oathText bytes.

geojsonCid.description: IPFS CID of WGS84 GeoJSON boundary (±1m precision).

imageryBundleCid.description: IPFS CID of satellite imagery time series bundle (≥3 months, Sentinel-2 / Landsat / commercial).

deedCid.description: IPFS CID of notarized national registry deed PDF.

nationalRegistryRef.description: Canonical national registry reference (e.g., 'JP:東京都:文京区:本郷:123-4').

stewardDid.description: Initial steward DID (typically the donor; assigned Lv5 護 role).

successionDeclarationUri.description: AT URI of the steward-succession-declaration record (per ADR-2605192345 — primary + 2 backup successors REQUIRED at donation time).

oathTextVersion.description: Lexicon-tracked oath text version. v1 = the original 2026-05-17 text. Bumps when canonical text revises.

oathTextLanguage.description: Language variant the aspirant signed. Both ja and en are canonical; aspirant signs one (their choice).

oathText.description: Full oath text as signed. Must match the canonical text for the (version, language) pair byte-exact.

oathHashKeccak256Hex.description: keccak256(utf8(oathText)) lower-case hex without 0x prefix. Used as the bytes32 argument to EtzhayyimMembership.join().

did.description: Aspirant's DID. did:web:* / did:plc:* / did:key:* accepted.

didSignatureBase64url.description: DID-bound signature over the oathText bytes. Verification: resolve did → publicKey → verify against oathText. base64url no padding.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. v0.1 = 8453 (Base mainnet) or 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet).

membershipTxHash.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash of the EtzhayyimMembership.join() call.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-4337 Smart Account address that signed the on-chain join().

githubUsername.description: Optional github handle. Matches the second argument to join() if provided. Used by MEMBERS.md PR validation.

fallbackPath.description: Path if all primary + backup successors decline or are unavailable. Per ADR-2605192345 §4.

supersedes.description: Optional AT URI of a prior declaration this one replaces (donor can update during their lifetime).

triggerEvidenceCid.description: IPFS CID of evidence (death certificate / medical attestation / absence attestation / step-down record / Charter Compliance attestation tx ref).

successionDeclarationUri.description: AT URI of the donor's original steward-succession-declaration.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor who named this successor.

successorRole.description: Position in the donor's succession declaration.

willAcceptStewardship.description: Must be true for the pre-acceptance to be valid.

acknowledgmentText.description: Canonical text: 'I acknowledge that if I succeed as steward of land #{landId}, I accept Lv5 護 stewardship duties (annual boundary inspection, biodiversity census, reasonable adherent access, no commercial extraction, national obligation maintenance) per ADR-2605192245 §5.1 and §1.11 of the Mission Charter.'

successorSignature.description: DID-bound signature by successor over the acknowledgmentText.

fromRegistrar.description: Source registrar (only squarespace supported in v1)

requesterDid.description: DID of user who initiated the transfer

projectConvoId.description: Convo room scoping all transferStep records

transferRequestUri.description: AT URI of the parent com.etzhayyim.apps.dns.transferRequest

actorDid.description: Which actor DID executed this step

bindZoneFileUri.description: B2 blob URI for exported BIND zone file (step 4 only)

cfTransferId.description: Cloudflare Registrar API transfer job id (step 5 only)

license.description: CC variant / SPDX ID / CMO blanket / commercial / PD

text.description: post 本文 (検索 index 対象、表示は 200 char snippet)

optOutSignal.description: 検出した opt-out 種別 (none 以外は ingest 停止)

sourceRkey.description: null の場合は repo 全体 tombstone (account 削除)

bgCid.description: Blob CID of the background image (typ. higher resolution than frame for PAN/TU headroom).

layeredCid.description: Blob CID of the layered BG doc (sky / mid / fore + book layers).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the character reference sheet (front/side/back + expressions).

voiceCast.description: Voice actor DID or name (public credit — Tier 2 ok; private contract data → Tier 3).

body.description: Message body. If prefixed 'signal:v1:' the content is Signal-encrypted (e.g. personal critique).

tool.description: Invoked AI tool name (if this message is an actor response, e.g. 'storyboarder.propose').

lightingCondition.description: Color set is per lighting condition. Multiple colorModel records per character allowed (one per condition).

materialMap.description: Blob CID of the material index image (each pixel = material ID, used by AI segmentation).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the painted reference sheet.

colorLayersCid.description: Blob CID of the layered color doc (base / shadow1 / shadow2 / highlight / rim).

flatCid.description: Blob CID of the flattened colored frame (for preview / composite input).

outputCid.description: Blob CID of the composited cut (mp4 or image sequence).

cutNum.description: Cut number within the episode (1-indexed, globally unique per episode regardless of scene).

durationFrames.description: Cut length in frames. Duration in seconds = durationFrames / fps.

fps.description: Frame rate for this cut (24 full / 12 limited / 8 super-limited). Overrides episode.fps.

dialogueSummary.description: One-line dialogue/action summary for board display.

priority.description: 'retake' = outstanding retake exists; board highlights red.

convoId.description: Project convoId (= roomId). Knowledge graph records in this episode are scoped by this id.

durationSec.description: Target duration in seconds (typ. 1410 = 23m30s for TV).

fps.description: Episode default fps (24 full, 12 limited). Overrides work.fps.

status.description: Pipeline stage indicator (coarse). Per-cut progress lives in `cut.status`.

masterCid.description: Blob CID of the final master video (mp4/mov). Set on delivery.

thumbCid.description: Episode thumbnail. Consumed by derive rule as embed.images[0].

frameNum.description: Frame number within the cut (0-indexed). Must be strictly between prevKey.frameNum and nextKey.frameNum.

method.description: How this frame was produced. 'reuse' = copy of adjacent frame (holdout).

author.description: Human DID or inbetweener actor DID.

imageCid.description: Blob CID of the keyframe drawing.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI layered doc (line + tie-down layers).

layerRole.description: X-sheet layer column (A = foreground / main char, B/C/D = secondary, book = static overlay).

tiePose.description: Pose / expression tag for cross-frame consistency check.

layoutCid.description: Blob CID of the layout drawing (KAMI layered format preferred).

lightingDirection.description: Lighting direction note for finishers (e.g. '上手 45°', 'モノトーン').

convoId.description: Project convo / room id. All knowledge-graph records scoped by this id.

indexCid.description: Optional R2 index blob CID for fast project tree load.

targetUri.description: AT URI of the record being retaken.

stage.description: Pipeline stage the retake applies to.

timecodeFrame.description: Frame pin within the cut (for per-frame comments). Omit for cut-level retake.

author.description: Reviewer DID (typ. director or episode director).

assignee.description: DID expected to fix (overrides cut.assignees if set).

resolvedByUri.description: AT URI of the new record that resolves this retake (e.g. updated keyframe).

headingJP.description: Scene heading (e.g. 'S#12 / 夜 / 校舎屋上').

mood.description: Emotional tone (tense / calm / heroic / melancholy ...). Used by bgArtist lighting design.

cutCount.description: Realized cut count (set after cut breakdown).

bodyCid.description: Blob CID of the script body (.txt / .fountain / .fdx).

format.description: Script format. 'hakoden' = Japanese anime 箱書き format.

sceneCount.description: Parsed scene count (set after scene split).

assetCid.description: Blob CID of the audio asset (wav/ogg/mp3).

line.description: Dialogue text for voice tracks (from script).

thumbCid.description: Blob CID of the storyboard thumbnail sketch.

candidateNum.description: 1..3 if this is one of the AI-proposed candidates; omitted for human-authored single board.

dialogue.description: Dialogue text (JP primary, spoken lines + character attribution).

soundNote.description: SE / BGM hint (e.g. 'SE: 扉を開ける').

durationFramesHint.description: Proposed cut length in frames (refines cut.durationFrames on approval).

genre.description: Primary genre (action / drama / slice-of-life / sci-fi etc.).

episodeCount.description: Planned total episode count (informational; actual episodes are separate com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.episode records).

fps.description: Default fps for this work (24 for full animation, 12 for limited). Can be overridden per-cut.

coverCid.description: Blob CID of the key visual image. Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image.

trailerUri.description: PV / trailer URL. Emitted as facet#link in the derived post.

scope.description: What this lease governs. Examples: 'firehose:app.bsky.feed.post', 'autoRespond:ameno', 'briefDispatcher'. Convention: stable kebab-case identifier.

holderDid.description: DID currently holding the lease. Receivers MUST verify the record is authored by this same DID (PDS-side signature) before honouring the lease.

generation.description: Monotonically incrementing counter. Takeovers MUST publish generation > the previous record's generation, so concurrent claimants converge on a single winner.

issuedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease was first claimed.

expiresAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease must be renewed or relinquished. Recommend issuedAt + 5 minutes.

renewedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the holder most recently renewed. Allowed to be equal to issuedAt.

computeMode.description: Holder's compute mode at lease time (local / daemon-a / daemon-b / custom). Advisory; lets followers reason about why the leader was chosen.

model.description: Holder's loaded model id, if relevant to the scope.

note.description: Free-form human-readable note (e.g. reason for takeover).

b2Key.description: B2 blob key for the STEP / CadQuery / GLB file.

licenseTier.description: IMMUTABLE at INSERT. apache2 = Zero-To-CAD (commercial). adsk-noncommercial = Make-A-Shape / WaLa (research namespace only).

cadqueryCode.description: CadQuery Python code. Populated for format=cadquery and format=step.

tsukuruPackageId.description: Set after exportToTsukuru. null until exported.
